tests.prompt: Add Playwright E2E tests for our Next.js app's login and 'create project' flow. Login is email + password; projects are saved through /api/projects.
tests.good: Detects existing config or proposes one with webServer, trace on-first-retry and CI retries; logs in once in a setup project and reuses storageState, with one dedicated login-UI test; role/label locators; web-first assertions and waits on the /api/projects response, no waitForTimeout; keeps the app's own API real with unique test data; stubs only third parties; tests run independently in parallel; gives the run command and how to read a trace.

tests.prompt: test_checkout_applies_discount fails about 1 in 10 CI runs but always passes on my machine. Here's the CI error: AssertionError: expected order total 90.00, got 100.00 (the discount row lookup returned another test's code).
tests.good: Doesn't skip, retry or raise timeouts; classifies as identifier collision or shared-state ordering from the error; looks for low-resolution or hard-coded discount codes and sibling tests sharing them; fixes at the source (unique per-test codes, factory) and sweeps the file; explains that local passes don't verify and proposes CI verification (baseline vs fix runs); states confidence.

tests.prompt: Write tests for this Python function that parses and formats ISO durations like 'PT1H30M' into seconds and back.
tests.good: Watches tests fail first or explains the TDD order; example tests with hand-derived expected values and named edge cases (zero, missing parts, invalid strings raise); a property-based roundtrip test (Hypothesis) offered or used if installed, with generators building valid durations rather than filtering; no tautological assertions; pytest parametrize with ids; runs the suite and reports results.

tests.prompt: Add Playwright E2E tests for the signup and checkout flows of our Next.js shop and run them on every pull request in GitHub Actions, split across four machines. The checkout form must also pass an accessibility check.
tests.good: States a short plan first: test-strategy.md and playwright-e2e.md here; the workflow through cloud-devops (ci-cd.md: least-privilege permissions, pinned actions, cached dependencies, a four-way shard matrix, reports uploaded on failure); the accessibility check through frontend-ui-design (accessibility.md: labelled inputs, a full keyboard path, visible focus). Role-based locators, web-first assertions, no fixed waits; storageState auth and unique test data; payments stubbed; shard reports merged and traces kept on retry; watches each test fail first; runs it in CI or says it couldn't; checks the Done means of all three crafts.
